title: What actually reduces workplace stress?
post_summary: A live online panel with four HR and People leaders sharing what really helps with workplace stress, what’s working, what isn’t, and what they would do differently.
post_body:
Join us online on 2 October at 11:00 CET for a live panel with four HR and People leaders sharing what really helps with workplace stress—what’s working, what isn’t, and what they would do differently.

The conversation brings together perspectives from learning and development, talent, inclusion and workplace experience, followed by a short guided breathwork session.

The panel is free to attend.

title: Office Impact Summit
post_title: A first summit and the start of something ongoing
post_summary: More than 60 of you joined us. THANK YOU for being part of our first edition and helping bring this community to life!
post_body:
Office Managers make a huge difference in how it feels to work at a company.
Last Friday, we brought them together for a day dedicated to them.

The first-ever Office Impact Summit at DB55 was about recognizing that contribution and creating space for Office, Facilities, and Workplace Experience professionals to connect, share ideas, and build a community.
event_summary: A full day for office, workplace and facilities professionals: keynotes, roundtables, wellbeing moments and peer connection.
event_details: The first Office Impact Summit was created for the people who run the workplace and shape how it feels. The programme combined practical roundtables, keynote sessions and time to connect with peers.
